purpose: Claims-controlled external evidence register for defensive quantum-cryptography migration analysis.
claims_boundary: External publications and vendor roadmaps support the scientific and planning premises listed here. They do not constitute external validation of Worldshepherd, proof of a production key break, or proof that a cryptographically relevant quantum computer exists today. Vendor roadmaps are forward-looking evidence, not demonstrated capability.

items.finding: Complete secp256k1 ECDLP circuits are reported at <=1200 logical qubits and <=90M Toffoli gates or <=1450 logical qubits and <=70M Toffoli gates; stated superconducting scenarios execute in minutes with fewer than 500,000 physical qubits under the paper's assumptions.
items.allowed_use: External benchmark and migration-risk input only.

items.finding: A trapped-ion Walking Cat architecture estimate reports about 1,450 logical qubits, 40M Toffoli gates, 19,397 physical qubits and 25.7 days per secp256k1 ECDLP attempt with a stated success estimate under the paper's assumptions.
items.allowed_use: Architecture-specific sensitivity bound; not a demonstrated cryptographic break.

items.finding: IonQ's public roadmap targets 10,000 physical / 800 logical qubits in 2027 and 20,000 physical / 1,600 logical qubits in 2028. The 2028 target numerically overlaps IonQ's own published Walking Cat secp256k1 attack envelope of 19,397 physical / about 1,450 logical qubits.
items.allowed_use: Forward migration-planning trigger only. The overlap may increase migration urgency but must not be reported as demonstrated attack capability, Q-day, or proof that the roadmap will be achieved.

items.finding: A complete prime-field ECDLP Shor construction is reported at 835 logical qubits for a 256-bit curve, with a large Toffoli cost whose leading term is 919*n^3/log2(n).
items.allowed_use: Logical-width frontier only; no physical runtime may be inferred without architecture-specific compilation.

items.finding: The [[20,2,6]] C4-Helix architecture was experimentally validated on Quantinuum Helios, including repeated QEC, logical Clifford benchmarking and heterogeneous-code logical entanglement, with encoded results outperforming physical baselines without postselection.
items.allowed_use: Hardware-QEC progress input only; do not multiply the measured code-block ratio into an attack estimate without a complete architecture-specific fault-tolerant overhead model.

items.finding: The earlier QCRYPTO Risk Gate completed successfully on exact branch head 4c39d73b965969e1617bea0485175d4654784611. Later roadmap-collision updates require their own CI status and are not covered by that historical run.
items.allowed_use: Historical internal software-quality evidence only; not independent scientific validation or external certification.
